title: Aviation Technology Consulting for Airlines
intro: AeroExpert provides independent aviation technology consulting to commercial airlines of all sizes — from full-service network carriers and low-cost operators to charter airlines and hybrid carriers. We advise on the technology systems that underpin airline commercial operations, flight operations, safety and digital transformation.

services.title: Passenger Service Systems
services.desc: PSS strategy, vendor selection, migration and optimisation — the core commercial system for every airline.

services.title: Flight Operations Technology
services.desc: EFB, flight planning, crew management, OCC and flight data monitoring — the systems that keep operations safe and efficient.

services.title: Revenue Management
services.desc: RM system selection, process design and the transition to modern offer/order-based retailing.

services.title: NDC & ONE Order
services.desc: Modern airline retailing strategy, NDC implementation and ONE Order transition planning.

services.title: Cybersecurity
services.desc: Specialist aviation cybersecurity risk assessment, maturity assessment and IT governance.

services.title: Digital Transformation
services.desc: Digital maturity assessment, technology roadmap, legacy modernisation and AI use cases.

closing: To discuss your airline's technology requirements, contact us.
